## Subcycle Taxonomy & Velocity Corridors

- [x] CHK001 Are the exact weekly percentage bounds (`minWeeklyPct` and `maxWeeklyPct`) and display titles defined for all three subcycle types (`Fat Loss`, `Recomposition`, `Muscle Gain`)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]

## 5-Zone Velocity Spectrum & Strict Inequality Rules

- [x] CHK004 Are global outer safety bounds (`< -1.00%/wk` and `> +0.75%/wk`) explicitly specified to take precedence over subcycle-specific rules across all active subcycle types? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK005 Are shared boundary values (`-1.00%`, `-0.25%`, `0.00%`, `+0.25%`, `+0.75%`) unambiguously assigned via strict `<`, `<=`, `>`, `>=` inequalities for each active subcycle? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK006 Are both the badge label copy and the inline coaching helper subtitle copy explicitly defined for every diagnostic state across `Fat Loss`, `Recomposition`, `Muscle Gain`, and `Calibrating`? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, §FR-004, §FR-005]
- [x] CHK007 Are the 5-segment gauge width proportions (`15% | 22.5% | 25% | 22.5% | 15%`) and zone boundaries specified? [Measurability, Spec §FR-007]

## Composite-Only Warning Architecture & MCP Parity

- [x] CHK008 Does the specification explicitly restrict diagnostic warning badges, 5-zone corridor gauges, and helper subtitles to the primary `✦ Weekly Body Weight` composite row while omitting per-row badges/gauges on `7D`, `14D`, `21D`, and `28D` rows? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK009 Are light and dark mode semantic color tokens specified for `OPTIMAL_GREEN`, `WARNING_AMBER`, and `CRITICAL_RED` severity tiers? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK010 Are Coaching MCP Server input/output schema requirements defined for canonical and legacy subcycle identifiers, `global_safety_bounds`, and composite diagnostic fields? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010]
